blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Introducing new capabilities to frontier models has long been the goal of posttraining, which predominantly employs supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to this end. Conventional wisdom dictates that RL enables strong generalization on new tasks without losing existing capabilities, while SFT is prone to weak generalization and catastrophic forgetting. At the same time, SFT can learn from off-policy expert data, whereas RL must rely on a model’s ability to find successful trajectories with repeated sampling. In our work, we seek to leverage the strength of on-policy learning while utilizing the privileged information contained in off-policy data. However, rather than modifying the learning objective to accommodate this data, we instead tailor the data distribution to better suit the learner. We introduce a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling algorithm that progressively transforms off-policy traces to be more on-policy given a reference model for finetuning. Across tasks like scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise, our sampling algorithm enables SFT to rival prevailing posttraining techniques, often generalizing better and forgetting less than strong on-policy baselines. In addition, the resulting finetuned models exhibit strong distributional performance and are capable of learning beyond sharpening the base model distribution. At a higher level, our approach presents sampling as a model-native operator that shapes data for learnability , offering broader utility as a general-purpose primitive throughout the posttraining stack.
blocks.zh: 长期以来,将新的能力引入前沿模式一直是后培训的目标,培训主要采用监督的微调和强化学习。 常规的智慧决定了RL能够在不丧失现有能力的情况下对新任务进行有力的概括,而SFT则容易被弱的概括和灾难性的遗忘. 与此同时,SFT可以从政策外的专家数据中学习,而RL则必须依靠模型的能力,通过反复取样找到成功的轨迹. 在我们的工作中,我们力求利用政策学习的力量,同时利用非政策数据中的特殊信息。 然而,我们不是修改学习目标以适应这些数据,而是调整数据分布以更好地适应学习者。 我们引入了马可夫链式蒙特卡洛(MCMC)采样算法,该算法将逐渐改变政策外的痕迹,使之更具政策性,成为微调的参考模型。 在科学技能的获取、数学推理和无限制的专业知识等任务中,我们的抽样算法使SFT能够与流行的后培训技术相竞争,往往能很好地概括并忘记比强的政策基线。 此外,由此而来的微调模型表现出强烈的分布性能,能够学习超越磨损基模型分布. 在更高层次上,我们的做法将采样作为模型-本土操作器,它塑造了数据可学习性,在整个培训后堆中作为通用原始物提供了更广泛的用途。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Posttraining has brought about revolutionary advances in the capabilites of frontier large language models (LLMs) ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) , giving sizeable performance gains across domains like math, science, and coding ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Rein et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 后训练在前沿大语言模型(LLMs)的卡比比力(Guo et al., 2025;Hu et al., 2025)带来了革命性的进步,在数学,科学和编码等领域都取得了相当大的成绩(Hendrycks等人, 2021;Li等人, 2022;Rein等人, 2024).

blocks.en: Still, a key open question remains: how can we introduce fundamentally new capabilities during posttraining without giving up existing ones ? A large body of recent literature has been dedicated to understanding the extent to which existing learning frameworks – i.e., supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) – can achieve this end. Overwhelming evidence ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Chu et al., 2025 ; Shenfeld et al., 2025 ) points towards RL as the paradigm of choice, citing superior generalization on unseen domains that appears to leave prior abilities intact. Meanwhile, SFT suffers from weak generalization and catastrophic forgetting ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) : a phenomenon where finetuned models exhibit significant deterioration in existing capabilities.
blocks.zh: 然而,一个关键的未决问题仍然是:我们如何能够在培训后不放弃现有能力的情况下引进全新的能力? 最近大量文献致力于了解现有学习框架(即监督微调(SFT)和强化学习(RL))在多大程度上能够实现这一目标。 压倒性的证据(Chen等人,2025年;Chu等人,2025年;Shenfeld等人,2025年)指出RL是选择的范式,引用了在看不见的领域优异的概括性,似乎保留了以前的能力。 同时,SFT也遭受了疲软的泛泛化和灾难性的遗忘(Kirkpatrick等人,2017年;Luo等人,2023年):这个被微调模型的现象表明现有能力明显恶化.

blocks.en: Chen et al. (2025) ; Shenfeld et al. (2025) attribute this performance gap to the on-policy nature of RL: the model’s own samples dictate learning updates, constraining finetuning towards distributions that do not stray far from the original starting point. SFT on the other hand is off-policy , leaving finetuning more susceptible to drastic updates and shifts in behavior ( Xiong et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: Chen等人(2025年);Shenfeld等人(2025年)将这一性能差距归因于RL的政策性:模型本身的样本决定了学习更新,制约着微调到不远离最初起点的分布. SFT则脱离政策,

blocks.en: At the same time, learning strictly on-policy is also a limitation, as it relies on the model’s own ability to find successful trajectories through repeated sampling. If the model cannot generate a correct rollout on a training sample, there is no collective variance in reward, resulting in no learning signal. Qu et al. (2026) observes this deficiency in practice, identifying a sizeable regime of hard training samples that are effectively discarded during RL as they are simply too difficult to yield any trainability.
blocks.zh: 同时,严格地学习政策也是一个限制,因为它依靠模型本身的能力,通过反复取样找到成功的轨迹。 如果模型不能在培训样本上产生正确的推出,则在奖励方面不存在集体差异,导致没有学习信号. Qu等人(2026年)在实践中注意到了这一缺陷,确定了大量硬性培训样品制度,这些样品在远程培训期间被有效抛弃,因为这些样品太难产生任何可训练性。

blocks.en: This limitation is not ideal for the purposes of introducing new capabilities, where the model is unlikely to already be competent enough to produce a successful trajectory. Here SFT has an advantage, as it leverages trajectories constructed from off-policy privileged information that provide rich supervision signal without necessitating an explicit reward.
blocks.zh: 这种限制对于引进新的能力来说并不理想,因为在这种能力中,模型不可能已经足以产生成功的轨道。 在此,SFT有一个优势,因为它利用了从非政策特权信息中构建的轨道,这种信息提供丰富的监督信号,而不需要明确的奖励。

blocks.en: In this work, rather than modifying the learning algorithm to accommodate off-policy data, we ask if we can instead shape the data distribution to accommodate learning. More precisely, can we algorithmically sample on-policy trajectories that remain faithful to privileged off-policy information ? To this end, we propose a sampling algorithm that progressively transforms a dataset of off-policy expert traces to be distributionally closer to a given base model distribution.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们不是修改学习算法以容纳政策外的数据,而是问我们是否能够塑造数据分布以容纳学习。 更确切地说,我们可以算法地对政策轨迹进行抽样,这些轨迹仍然忠实于特权政策外信息吗? 为此,我们提出了一个取样算法,该算法将一套非政策专家追踪的数据集逐步转换,以便更接近某一基准模型的分布。

Left: we compare SFT composed with our sampling algorithm for off-policy data against SFT on the original dataset and an on-policy learning algorithm that integrates off-policy data into self-distillation (OPSD) ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) . blocks.en: Remarkably, this sampling step enables SFT to rival prevailing posttraining techniques, often generalizing better and forgetting less than strong on-policy learning algorithms .
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,这一取样步骤使SFT能够与当时流行的后培训技术相竞争,往往能更好地概括并忘记比强的政策学习算法更少。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We introduce a framework that formalizes the task of transforming off-policy data into on-policy data for finetuning. Namely, given a base model and a dataset of expert trajectories, we specify a target data generation policy that preserves the information content of the original dataset while maintaining maximal proximity to the base model distribution. • To generate boosted samples from this policy, we introduce projection sampling , an approximate sampling algorithm using Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) techniques that iteratively refine expert trajectories according to their likelihoods with respect to the base model. • We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of our sampling procedure for SFT over a range of tasks, including scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise. Our results show that SFT with sampling can outperform on-policy counterparts like RL and self-distillation on new task generalization as well as prior capability retention.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们引入了一个框架,正式确定将非政策数据转化为政策数据的任务,以进行微调。 也就是说,鉴于一个基础模型和一个专家轨迹数据集,我们规定了目标数据生成政策,在保持与基础模型分布的最大距离的同时,保留原始数据集的信息内容。 为了从这一政策中产生增强的样品,我们采用了投影取样法,这是一种使用Markov链式Monte Carlo(MCMC)技术的近似取样算法,它根据专家在基准模型方面的可能性,反复改进专家的轨迹。 我们从经验上证明,我们在科学技能的获取、数学推理和不限成员名额的专门知识等一系列任务中,对SFT的取样程序是有效的。 我们的结果显示,带样本的SFT能够比RL等政策对应方表现得更好,在新任务概括和以前的能力保留方面能够自我消化。

blocks.en: We introduce a framework that formalizes the task of transforming off-policy data into on-policy data for finetuning. Namely, given a base model and a dataset of expert trajectories, we specify a target data generation policy that preserves the information content of the original dataset while maintaining maximal proximity to the base model distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个框架,正式确定将非政策数据转化为政策数据的任务,以进行微调。 即赋予一个基础模型和一个专家轨迹数据集,我们规定一个目标数据生成政策,在保持与基础模型分布最大距离的同时,保留原始数据集的信息内容.

blocks.en: To generate boosted samples from this policy, we introduce projection sampling , an approximate sampling algorithm using Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) techniques that iteratively refine expert trajectories according to their likelihoods with respect to the base model.
blocks.zh: 为了从这一政策中产生增强的样品,我们采用了投影取样法,即使用马尔科夫链式蒙特卡洛(MCMC)技术的近似取样算法,根据专家在基准模型方面的可能性,迭代地完善了专家的轨迹。

blocks.en: We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of our sampling procedure for SFT over a range of tasks, including scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise. Our results show that SFT with sampling can outperform on-policy counterparts like RL and self-distillation on new task generalization as well as prior capability retention.
blocks.zh: 我们从经验上证明,我们在科学技能的获取、数学推理和不限成员名额的专门知识等一系列任务中,对SFT的取样程序是有效的。 我们的结果显示,带样本的SFT能够比RL等政策对应方表现得更好,在新任务概括和以前的能力保留方面能够自我消化。

blocks.en: Our results collectively illustrate that composing sampling with finetuning is a powerful paradigm that can enable a learning algorithm as standard as SFT to perform far beyond conventional expectations.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果集体说明,用微调进行取样是一个强有力的范例,可以使学习算法作为标准,如SFT,实现远远超出常规预期。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: SFT vs. RL. Many recent works have investigated the performance gap between SFT and RL in posttraining. Chu et al. (2025) was an early work that noticed the gap in generalization performance, asserting SFT is prone to memorization while RL can generalize beyond the training distribution. Xiong et al. (2025) offers a mathematical explanation for this phenomenon, suggesting that training off-policy can result in large and unstable gradient updates that encourage overfitting and harm generalization. Shenfeld et al. (2025) and Chen et al. (2025) explore the performance gap from the lens of prior capability retention, noting that SFT is highly susceptible to catastrophic forgetting ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) . Shenfeld et al. (2025) conducts extensive empirical analysis to attribute this to the off-policy nature of SFT and even shows that the level of forgetting correlates with the KL divergence of the finetuned model with the base model. Similarly, Chen et al. (2025) offers a mode-seeking rationale and concludes similarly that on-policy data mitigates forgetting while off-policy data facilitates it.
blocks.zh: SFT对RL. 最近的许多作品都调查了SFT和RL在培训后的表现差距. Chu等人(2025年)是一部早期的作品,注意到通化性能的差距,断言SFT容易被记忆,而RL则可以通化到训练分配之外. Xiong等人(2025年)为这一现象提供了数学解释,认为非政策培训可能导致大规模和不稳定的梯度更新,从而鼓励过度适应和伤害泛化. Shenfeld等人(2025年)和Chen等人(2025年)从先前的能力保留角度探索性能差距,指出SFT极易发生灾难性遗忘(Kirkpatrick等人,2017年;Luo等人,2023年). Shenfeld等人(2025年)进行了广泛的实证分析,将此归因于SFT的非政策性质,甚至表明遗忘的程度与微调模型与基准模型的KL差异相关. 同样, Chen等人(2025年)提供了一个寻找模式的理由,并同样得出结论,即政策数据减轻了遗忘,而政策外数据则促进忘却。

blocks.en: Several works also attempt to bridge the gap between SFT and RL by interpolating between off-policy and on-policy learning. Both Liu et al. (2025) and Qu et al. (2026) construct variants of GRPO ( Guo et al., 2025 ) that use expert data in-context to encourage generating correct rollouts for hard problems during RL, treating them as vanilla generations during training. On the SFT side, Wu et al. (2025) modulates the SFT objective with importance sampling weights to match the on-policy gradient, while Zhu et al. (2025) adds a KL divergence term to further encourage proximity to the base model. While these approaches alter the learning objective to better account for off-policy data, our approach leaves SFT intact, and instead focuses on modulating off-policy data to be more on-policy.
blocks.zh: 一些工作还试图通过在政策外学习与政策上学习之间插图,弥合SFT和RL之间的差距。 刘等(2025年)和邱等均著. (2026年)构建了GRPO的变体(Guo等人,2025年),使用专家的内在数据来鼓励在RL期间为困难问题产生正确的推广,在训练期间将其作为香草代处理. SFT方面,吴等. (2025年)用重要采样权重来调制SFT目标,以配合政策梯度,而Zhu等人(2025年)则增加了KL差异词,以进一步鼓励接近基准模型. 虽然这些方法改变了更好地核算政策外数据的学习目标,但我们的方法使SFT不受影响,而是侧重于调整政策外数据,使其更具政策性。

blocks.en: An on-policy alternative to RL that has recently begun to gain recognition for incorporating off-policy data is self-distillation . Self-distillation typically constructs a teacher model from a base model by conditioning on privileged information ; e.g., expert data or environment feedback, which is then distilled via a KL divergence loss. Several works ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) offer variations on this idea and demonstrate promising results. OPSD ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , which we refer to as a baseline in this paper, offers one promising avenue for continual learning: i.e., adapting to new tasks without forgetting.
blocks.zh: 最近开始因纳入政策外数据而获得认可, 自我消化通常通过对特殊信息(例如专家数据或环境反馈)的调制,从基模型中构建一个师范模型,然后通过KL差值损失进行蒸馏。 一些作品(Shenfeld等人,2026年;Ye等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年)对这一想法提出了不同的看法,并显示出有希望的结果。 OPSD(Shenfeld et al., 2026;Zhao et al., 2026),我们在本文中称之为基线,为继续学习提供了一条很有希望的途径:即适应新的任务而不忘记。

blocks.en: Prior research has also explored how to integrate MCMC methods into LLM sampling. Several works have explored using MCMC to tilt to an external reward function ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Faria et al., 2024 ) or probabilistic program ( Lew et al., 2023 ) . Most related to our work are Karan and Du (2025) , Azizi et al. (2026) , Arzhantsev et al. (2026) , which use MCMC sampling to sample from a sharpened distribution for reasoning. Other works expand on this framework by targeting critical tokens ( Li et al., 2025 ) to make MCMC sampling more efficient ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, our approach uses sampling to transform off-policy data for subsequent finetuning.
blocks.zh: 先前的研究还探讨如何将MCMC方法纳入LM取样. 若干作品探索了利用MCMC向外部奖励功能倾斜(Zhao等人,2024年;Faria等人,2024年)或概率方案(Lew等人,2023年)。 与我们的工作最相关的是Karan和Du(2025年),Azizi等人(2026年),Arzhantsev等人(2026年),他们使用MCMC采样从更尖锐的分布中进行采样以进行推理. 其他工作通过瞄准关键标志来扩展这一框架(Li等人,2025年),以提高MCMC采样的效率(周等人,2026年;Ji等人,2026年)。 与此相对照,我们的方法是采用抽样方法转换非政策数据,以便随后进行微调。

blocks.en: In this section, we present our sampling algorithm that maps off-policy expert data closer to the base model distribution for finetuning. Our procedure formalizes interpolating off-policy information into on-policy learning as highlighted in Section 1 . To construct an informational-equivalent dataset that is easiest for the base model to internalize, we must provide a generation policy that maintains this information with minimal KL divergence. This specifies a target data generation distribution, and hence, all that remains is for us to explicitly provide an algorithm that samples from it.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了我们的取样算法,该算法将非政策专家数据绘制到更接近基准模型分布的地方,以进行微调。 正如第1节所强调的,我们的程序正式将非政策信息插入政策学习。 为了构建一个信息等同的数据集,使基准模型内部化,我们必须提供一种一代政策,以最小的KL差异来维持这一信息。 这规定了一个目标数据生成分布,因此,剩下的只是我们明确提供一个从中取样的算法。

blocks.en: The remainder of the section is organized as follows. Section 4.1 presents our formalization specifying this (unnormalized) boosted target data policy. Section 4.2 introduces a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm that approximately samples from this policy and ensures our sampling procedure produces generation policies that get progressively closer to the base model distribution. Finally, Section 4.3 outlines our implementation of this algorithm for LLMs.
blocks.zh: 本节其余部分编排如下. 第4.1节介绍了我们正式规定的这一(非正常的)增强目标数据政策。 第4.2节引入了Markov链式Monte Carlo(MCC)算法,该算法从这一政策中抽取了大约样本,并确保我们的取样程序产生逐渐接近基准模型分布的生成政策。 最后,第4.3节概述了我们实施LLMS这一算法的情况。

blocks.en: 4.3 Projection Sampling for LLMs
blocks.zh: 4.3 法学硕士的预测抽样

blocks.en: As detailed in Karan and Du (2025) , a direct implementation of Metropolis-Hastings for LLMs is infeasible as it requires regenerating full-length token sequences with repeated LLM inference calls. This infeasibility is further compounded by slow mixing , where convergence can require exponentially many MCMC steps due to high dimensional sample spaces or poor choice of proposals and initializations.
blocks.zh: 正如Karan和Du(2025年)所详述的,直接实施Metropolis-Hastings的LLM是行不通的,因为它需要用反复的LLM推断调用来重新生成全长的符号序列. 这种不可行性因缓慢的混合而进一步复杂化,由于高维样本空间或提案和初始化的选择不当,趋同可能需要成倍的MCMC步骤。

blocks.en: To help avoid these issues, we adapt the implementation of Metropolis-Hastings for power sampling in Karan and Du (2025) , which we refer the reader to for further details. In short, we define restriction distributions of the target projection p 𝒞 p_{\mathcal{C}} over sequences of increasing length in units of block size B B . We use Metropolis-Hastings to sample within each distribution, providing a strong initialization to begin sampling from the next one. The full details are presented in Algorithm 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了避免这些问题,我们调整了大都会-哈斯廷斯在Karan和Du(2025年)的电力采样方案的实施,我们请读者进一步详细了解。 简言之,我们定义了目标投影p C p_{\mathcal{C}} 相对于区块大小B的单位长度增加的序列的限制分布. 我们利用大都会-哈斯廷斯 在每个分布区进行采样, 提供强大的初始化 从下一个开始采样。 详细情况见算法1。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We now empirically demonstrate that the trajectories generated by our sampling algorithm enable SFT to break its weak characterization, frequently outperforming existing on-policy learning algorithms for posttraining.
blocks.zh: 我们现在实证地证明,我们的取样算法所产生的轨迹使SFT能够打破其薄弱的特征,经常优于现有的政策学习算法进行后培训。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We select a set of learning tasks that are characteristic of the range of capabilities posttraining seeks to introduce, including novel skill acquisition, reasoning, and open-ended expertise. In the following discussion, we present three tasks. Each learning task is accompanied by expert trajectories which are either inherent to the dataset or generated by GPT-5.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了一套学习任务,这些任务是培训后力求引进的各种能力的特点,包括获得新技能、推理和不限成员名额的专门知识。 在随后的讨论中,我们提出了三项任务。 每项学习任务都附有数据集所固有的或由GPT-5生成的专家轨迹。

blocks.en: • Chemistry: We examine whether a pretrained LLM can pick up a new set of skills that it is not explicitly finetuned on beforehand. Following Shenfeld et al. (2026) , we take scientific reasoning as the test domain. In this setting, we use Chemistry L-3 subset of SciKnowEval ( Feng et al., 2024 ) that includes skills like reaction prediction, molar weight calculation, and chemical equation balancing. Moreover, some questions follow a multiple choice format, while others (balancing) are freeform, representing a mixed dataset with a harder-to-specify reward for on-policy RL. There are 2400 problems total, with 1800 training problems and 600 test problems. Expert trajectories are generated by GPT-5. • Math: We investigate whether a pretrained LLM with some general mathematical ability can improve performance on a set of hard math reasoning problems relative to the base model. In this setting, we use the MATH ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) dataset restricted to the hardest problem classes: Levels 3, 4, and 5. There are 9254 problems total, with 8230 training problems and 1024 test problems that are accompanied by existing expert solutions. • Medical: We test whether our approach is effective in more open-ended domains that are not as immediately verifiable as the prior two. As in Shenfeld et al. (2026) , we look at medical question answering . We use the HuatuoGPT-o1 SFT dataset ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , which provides 19704 questions requiring clinical reasoning skills for diagnoses, treatments, and general medical knowledge, and each question has a provided expert response. For evaluation, we select 1000 questions uniformly at random from the HuatuoGPT-o1 RL dataset that are never seen during training.
blocks.zh: • 支助 化学: 我们研究预先受过训练的LLM是否能够获得一套新的技能,而这种技能在事先没有明确调整。 继Shenfeld等人(2026年)之后,我们把科学推理作为测试领域. 在这个设定中,我们使用了SciKnowEval(冯等人,2024年)的化学L-3子集,包括反应预测,摩尔重量计算,化学方程平衡等技能. 此外,有些问题遵循多种选择格式,而另一些问题(平衡)则属于自由形式,代表一个混合数据集,对政策RL的奖励更难于具体说明。 共有2400个问题,其中1800个培训问题,600个测试问题. 专家轨迹由GPT-5生成. ^ 数学:我们调查具有某种一般数学能力的预先训练的LLM能否在一组相对于基模型的硬数学推理问题上提高性能. 在此设置中,我们使用仅限于最难的问题类的MATH(Hendrycks等人,2021年)数据集:三级,四级和五级. 共有9254个问题,其中8230个培训问题,1024个测试问题,同时存在现有的专家解决方案. • 医疗: 我们检验我们的方法在较开放的领域中是否有效,这些领域不像前两个领域那样可以立即核查。 如Shenfeld等人(2026年), 我们使用HuatuoGPT-o1 SFT数据集(Chen等人,2024年),该数据集提供19704个问题,需要临床推理技能进行诊断,治疗,以及一般医学知识,每个问题都有专家提供的答复. 为评价起见,我们从HuatuoGPT-o1 RL数据集中统一随机选择1000个问题,这是训练期间从未见过的.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1: Sampling enables SFT to generalize better while forgetting less. Top: Chemistry on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.
Middle: Math on Qwen2.5-3B. Bottom: Medical on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. We bold the highest score in each column, and for math, we also bold if one of our listed approaches outperforms the other baselines, with a color gradient to emphasize numerical gaps. Across model sizes and evaluation tasks, sampling consistently enables SFT to generalize and retain prior capabilities at least as well as, if not better than, its on-policy posttraining counterparts.
blocks.zh:
表1:抽样使SFT能够更好地概括,同时忘记较少。 Top: Quen2.5-7B-Instruct上的化学.
中间:数学在Quen2.5-3B. 底部:医学在Quen2.5-7B-指令上. 我们大胆地在每一栏中打出最高的分数,对于数学来说,如果我们列出的其中一个方法比其他基线的成绩要好,用一个颜色梯度来强调数字差距,我们也大胆。 在整个模型规模和评价任务中,采样一直使SFT至少能够概括和保留先前的能力,即使不优于其政策后培训对应方的能力。

blocks.en: We display our main results for the Qwen model family in Table 1 . For results on Olmo, see Section 5.3 and Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们在表1中展示了我们对于Quen模型家族的主要结果. 关于奥尔莫的结果,见第5.3节和附录B。

blocks.en: Stronger generalization. Across different pretrained base models and different tasks, we see that projection sampling enables SFT to achieve an exceptionally strong performance when evaluated on new capabilities introduced in finetuning. In chemistry, sampling SFT is able to improve base model performance on chemistry by +31.7% , exceeding even the improvement yielded by the on-policy OPSD by +4.20% . Simple zero-shot rewrites of the off-policy traces do not perform as strongly in this setting, suggesting the importance of the full MCMC process in Algorithm 1 .
blocks.zh: 更强通论. 在不同的预先训练的基础模型和不同的任务中,我们看到投影取样使SFT能够在对微调中引入的新能力进行评价时取得特别强的业绩。 在化学中,采样SFT能够将化学上的基础模型性能提高+31.7%,甚至超过了政策OPSD产生的改进+4.20%. 简单的零镜头重写政策外的痕迹在此设定中的表现并不那么强烈,说明全MC进程在算法1中的重要性.

blocks.en: Math reasoning vividly illustrates that capability gains transfer to adjacent out-of-distribution test domains as well. Whereas vanilla SFT leads to a drop in performance across the board in math benchmarks, sampling SFT yields a +18.0% boost on the hardest problems in the MATH benchmark, even surpassing the reasoning boosts obtained by GRPO and UFT. This extends to a +14.4% boost on AMC and a +20.3% boost on GSM8K, which are on par with the boosts obtained by either RL algorithm. The performance gain on MATH500 is especially notable, providing a +33.7% boost to the base model and surpassing the next best performing (RL) baseline by +26.9% .
blocks.zh: 数学推理生动地说明,能力增益也转移到相邻的分配外测试域。 而香草SFT导致数学基准的全局性能下降,而采样SFT则在MATH基准中最难的问题上得到+18.0%的提升,甚至超过了GRPO和UFT所获得的推理提升. 这延伸到AMC的+14.4%的助推和GSM8K的+20.3%的助推,两者均与RL算法获得的助推值相当. MATH500的性能增益尤其显著,为基准模型提供了+33.7%的提升,并超过了次佳性能基线+26.9%。

blocks.en: Not only does the sampling SFT model generalize well, but it also provides a strong initialization for RL that leads to even further gains. In the math section of Table 1 , we record GRPO initialized with the sampling SFT checkpoint (Sampling SFT-RL) and observe that it is the strongest performing model overall, achieving +40.7% performance in MATH500 and +25.1% performance in GSM8K: within reach of the 7B-Instruct model.
blocks.zh: 采样的SFT模型不仅能很好地概括,而且能为RL提供强大的初始化,导致更进一步的收益. 在表1的数学部分,我们用抽样SFT检查站(Sampling SFT-RL)记录了GRPO初始化,并观察到它是总体性能最强的模型,在MATH500中实现+40.7%的性能,在GSM8K中实现+25.1%的性能:在7B-指令模型的可及范围内.

blocks.en: With just off-policy expert traces, SFT can fail to generalize well. But composed with our sampling algorithm, SFT can exhibit exceptionally strong generalization, even outperforming RL and OPSD baselines. The fact that this sampling procedure is custom to the base model distribution is crucial: Appendix B details results demonstrating that finetuning, e.g., Qwen on the same base task data but boosted for Olmo severely underperforms all baselines.
blocks.zh: 有了政策外的专家追踪,SFT可能无法很好地概括. 但是,由我们的取样算法组成,SFT可以表现出异常强的概括性,甚至比RL和OPSD基线表现强. 这种取样程序符合基本模型分布的习惯,这一点至关重要: 附 录 B详细显示微调结果,例如,在同一个基准任务数据上进行Quen,但对Olmo而言,这些结果大大低于所有基线。

blocks.en: Retaining prior capabilities. This strong generalization does not come at the cost of catastrophic forgetting. For chemistry in Table 1 , vanilla SFT results in a considerable drop in capabilities. Meanwhile, sampling SFT does not lose any MMLU knowledge and reduces the average loss in prior task accuracy down to just -1.10% . In fact, our model forgets the least , even including OPSD. These results are mirrored in the medical domain, where sampling recovers a 16.3% loss in average prior capabilities with vanilla SFT, and again, forgets the least among all baselines.
blocks.zh: 保留先前的能力。 这种强烈的概括并不以灾难性的遗忘为代价。 就表1中的化学而言,香草SFT导致能力大幅下降。 同时,取样SFT不会失去任何MMLU知识,并将先前任务精度的平均损失降至-1.10%。 事实上,我们的模型 忘记最少,甚至包括OPSD。 这些结果在医疗领域得到反映,在医疗领域,取样回收了香草SFT以往平均能力损失的16.3%,再次忘记了所有基线中最小的。

blocks.zh: 5.3 分析

blocks.en: We now examine distributional properties of our sampled traces for finetuning as well as those of the resulting model capabilities.

The on-policy projection is apparent, yielding traces that are much higher-likelihood relative to the base model while preserving correctness.

blocks.en: Learning beyond sharpening. In Section 1 , we highlighted the overarching goal of posttraining as introducing fundamentally new capabilities that are not present in the base model. Given that projection sampling pushes off-policy data to be more in-distribution, can our finetuned models still acquire new behaviors beyond just sharpening existing ones?
blocks.zh: 学习超越磨磨. 在第1节中,我们强调后期培训的首要目标是引进基本模式中没有的根本性的新能力。 鉴于投影抽样将政策数据推向更加分散,我们微调的模型是否仍然能够获得超越强化现有行为的新行为?

blocks.en: We answer in the affirmative. In Figure 4 , we examine the pass@ k k accuracy of Olmo-3-7B-Instruct relative to finetuning with sampling (ours) as well as on-policy distillation with privileged information (OPSD) on the science task. If finetuning with our sampling algorithm was simply sharpening existing capabilities, we would expect our pass@ k k curve to eventually converge to the base model. However, we actually see large, consistent gaps in the pass@ k k rate up to very large k k , demonstrating that our finetuned model has fundamentally stronger capabilities than the base model. Moreover, for k > 2 k>2 , we see substantial gaps in our pass@ k k rate relative to OPSD, indicating that our method enables learning capabilities that OPSD does not learn .

blocks.en: We can also be more granular at the the level of individual evaluation problems. In other words, we can identify “hard problems” that the base model absolutely cannot solve (pass@ k k rate zero for highest k k ) but our finetuned model can start reliably solving: in fact, some evaluation tasks go from zero pass rate in the base model to pass rates that are up to 67.2% or 53.1% .
blocks.zh: 在个别评价问题一级,我们也可以是比较颗粒的。 换句话说,我们可以找出基本模型绝对不能解决的“难题”(pass@ k k rate zero for highest k k k ),但我们的微调模型可以可靠地开始解决:事实上,一些评价任务从基础模型的零通过率到通过率高达67.2%或53.1%。

Proposition 3 observes that increasing the number of MCMC steps in projection sampling results in data generation policies π k \pi_{k} that are progressively closer to the base model in KL divergence. This frames sampling as a natural axis for scaling compute , expending more MCMC steps for more on-policy learning data.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce a formalism that bridges an apparent disconnect between privileged off-policy information and on-policy training. By carefully boosting the likelihood of off - policy expert data towards the base model’s distribution, we obtain a more on - policy equivalent that is far more suitable for learning. Indeed, across science, math reasoning, and open-ended expertise, SFT on boosted data can generalize better and forget less than both vanilla SFT and strong on - policy baselines, including RL and self - distillation. The resulting models also exhibit strong distributional performance over multiple samples and are able to learn fundamentally new capabilities that are not present in the base model.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了一种形式主义,它弥合了特权政策外信息和政策培训之间的明显脱节。 通过谨慎地提高政策专家数据向基本模式分布方向发展的可能性,我们获得了更适合学习的政策等同数据。 事实上,在科学、数学推理和开放性专门知识方面,增强数据的SFT可以比香草SFT和强的政策基线(包括RL和自我)更能概括和忘记。 由此产生的模型在多个样本上也表现出强烈的分布性能,能够学习基础模型中没有的根本性的新能力.

blocks.en: Beyond just SFT, sampling offers a powerful framework for the posttraining stack, acting as a model-native operator that shapes data for learnability. For example, for on-policy distillation, our MCMC process directly induces a teacher distribution from initial distillation traces that is much closer in KL divergence to the student, facilitating more stable updates. Likewise, conditioned on expert information, our method can simulate on-policy rollouts for RL on hard tasks where the base model is unable to generate signal. By expending sampling-time compute in exchange for stronger, more on-policy trace distributions constructed from privileged information, sampling provides a simple, robust, and scalable pathway for continually expanding LLM capabilities.
blocks.zh: 除了SFT之外,采样为训练后堆栈提供了强大的框架,充当模型-本土操作员,塑造数据以利学习. 例如,对于政策上的蒸馏,我们的MC进程直接诱导教师从初始蒸馏痕迹中进行分配,这些痕迹在KL差异中比学生更接近,有利于更稳定的更新. 同样,以专家信息为条件,在基础模型无法产生信号的情况下,我们的方法可以模拟RL在政策上推出的硬性任务。 通过使用抽样时间计算,以换取通过特权信息构建的更强大、更符合政策的政策跟踪分布,抽样为持续扩大LLM能力提供了简单、有力和可扩展的途径。

Medical (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) Question : Given the symptoms of sudden weakness in the left arm and leg, recent long-distance travel, and the presence of swollen and tender right lower leg, what specific cardiac abnormality is most likely to be found upon further evaluation that could explain these findings? Original : The specific cardiac abnormality most likely to be found in this scenario is a patent foramen ovale (PFO). This condition could allow a blood clot from the venous system, such as one from a deep vein thrombosis in the leg, to bypass the lungs and pass directly into the arterial circulation. This can occur when the clot moves from the right atrium to the left atrium through the PFO. Once in the arterial system, the clot can travel to the brain, potentially causing an embolic stroke, which would explain the sudden weakness in the left arm and leg. The connection between the recent travel, which increases the risk of deep vein thrombosis, and the neurological symptoms suggests the presence of a PFO facilitating a paradoxical embolism. Boosted : Given the patient’s history of recent long-distance travel, there is an increased risk of developing a deep vein thrombosis (DVT) due to prolonged immobility during the flight. This DVT, if it occurs in the right lower leg, can lead to swelling and tenderness in that area. Additionally, the presence of a patent foramen ovale (PFO) allows for a potential mechanism by which a clot from the DVT might bypass the pulmonary circulation and travel to the left side of the heart. From there, the clot could enter the systemic circulation and potentially cause an embolic event in the brain, leading to the sudden weakness in the left arm and leg. Therefore, upon further evaluation, the most likely finding would be: A patent foramen ovale (PFO), which facilitates the passage of a clot from the right side of the heart to the left side, allowing it to reach the cerebral circulation and cause a stroke-like presentation.

Medical (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) Question : A 4-year-old boy is brought to the emergency department with a morbilliform rash, fever, cracked lips, cervical lymphadenopathy, and desquamation of the perianal region, suggesting a condition that can lead to serious complications. Original : In this clinical scenario, the symptoms presented by the 4-year-old boy suggest Kawasaki disease, a condition especially relevant for its potential complications involving the heart. Most critically, the anatomical structures to evaluate in this case are the coronary arteries. This is because one of the severe complications of Kawasaki disease is the development of coronary artery aneurysms, which can lead to significant cardiac issues. Regular monitoring through echocardiography is often employed to assess the condition of the coronary arteries and ensure timely intervention if needed. Boosted : Based on the clinical presentation, the patient’s symptoms strongly suggest Kawasaki disease. The coronary arteries are the most critical anatomical structures to assess in this case. This is due to the high risk of developing coronary artery aneurysms, which can occur in up to 25% of untreated cases. These aneurysms can lead to serious cardiac issues such as myocardial infarction or sudden cardiac death. Therefore, regular echocardiographic monitoring is essential to detect any abnormalities early and provide timely intervention if necessary. In summary, the coronary arteries should be the primary focus when assessing this patient to prevent life-threatening complications associated with Kawasaki disease.

blocks.en: We also include two more comparative experiments for the Chemistry task for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to stress that the alignment between data distribution and learning distribution is crucial. For the first, we take the boosted dataset relative to Olmo-3-7B and finetune Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on that. We find the accuracy on Chemistry drops to 57.33% , which is significantly worse than the other baselines ( 61.8% for vanilla SFT). For the second experiment, we train Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on a 50/50 mix of boosted and original SFT data to see the effect of interpolation between off-and-on policy data. We find accuracy on Chemistry reaches 62.14% , in between standard SFT and SFT on the boosted dataset.
